notes: «أنه سمع عبد الرحمن بن أيمن ... يسأل ابن عمر»: the asker is inside a story Abu al-Zubayr tells, so he is only in the scene (rule 5); Ibn Umar, asked and answering, is the link (rule 6)
«فسأل عمر رسول الله» and Umar's words inside the story are scene, not links; the Prophet is the end
«قال ابن عمر وقرأ النبي» is Ibn Umar's own continuation
